title: The Signature Cybersecurity Education Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Defensive security concepts, safe labs, and account-protection guidance. The Cybersecurity Education Database teaches defensive security: how attacks work at a conceptual level so students can defend, safe lab exercises, account-protection practices like strong authentication, and how to recognize phishing and scams. All content is defensive; nothing here enables wrongdoing. The Signature side adds personal security checklists that harden a student's own accounts step by step.
capabilities: Teach defensive security concepts with safe labs
Document account-protection practices step by step
Train phishing and scam recognition
Provide personal security hardening checklists
Cover privacy settings across major platforms
